sources.quote: 1755, Un Discours sur l’Origine et les Fondemens de l’Inégalité parmi les Hommes (A Discourse on the Origin of Inequality; Second Discourse)
scours sur l’origine et les fondments de l’inegalite (Discourse on the Origin and Foundations of Inequality), 1755
In the following year he published his Discourse on the Origin and Foundations of Inequality among Men
1755, Un Discours sur l’Origine et les Fondemens de l’Inégalité parmi les Hommes
(Discourse on the Origin and Foundations of Inequality), 1755

notes: SEP ghi tên theo chính tả bản in 1755 ('Fondemens'); bản ghi dùng chính tả hiện đại 'fondements', hợp lý.
